distribution.narrative: Cao et al. (2022) reported Scolytus jaroschewskii from Xinjiang at species rank, without identifying a subspecies. The record is linked provisionally to Scolytus jaroschewskii jaroschewskii for database indexing only. This does not establish occurrence of the nominate subspecies in Xinjiang. Subspecies assignment remains unresolved.

host_note: Host information has not yet been reviewed for this checklist record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytus jaroschewskii jaroschewskii Schevyrew, 1893.
